visibility.label: Who can see this?
visibility.invitedText: Only people and groups you invite.
visibility.groupText: Everybody who may read the group.
visibility.linkText: Whoever knows the link. It does not show in search or lists.
visibility.publicText: Everybody, even without an account. It shows in Wissen and search.

license.label: Licence
license.cc_by_sa: CC BY-SA: share under the same terms
license.hint: Public documents need a licence. It says what others may do with them. With a CC licence people may keep a copy in their own Wissen.

access.title: Rights and sharing
access.edit_group: Everybody in the group with the right to edit files
access.downloadHint: When off, there is only the view in the browser. Screenshots can never be prevented, and what was downloaded cannot be taken back.
access.transferText: Another person becomes the owner. They have to accept.

page.noDownload: Download is switched off for this document. You can view it in the browser.
page.noView: This document can only be downloaded, but downloading is switched off.
page.restoreConfirm: This version becomes the newest. Nothing is lost.
page.suggestNote: What should be different, and why?
page.suggestSent: Your suggestion now waits for the people in charge.
page.trashConfirm: The document goes to the trash for {days} days. After that it is deleted for good.
page.locked: Somebody else is editing the document right now. Wait a moment or suggest a change.
page.lockMine: The document is locked for you while you write.
page.changeNotePlaceholder: e.g. added a paragraph on mulch
page.viaLink: You see this document through a shared link.

docs.empty: You have not shared or written anything yet.
docs.trashHint: After {days} days everything here is deleted for good.
docs.purgeConfirm: Delete for good? This cannot be undone.
docs.transferText: {by} wants to hand “{title}” over to you.

deleteAccount.keep: My contributions in groups stay with the group
deleteAccount.keepHint: Off: these documents are deleted too. Personal documents are always deleted.
